title_zh: 预约检查反复敲响的水管

scenario.label_zh: 预约检查水管敲击声和水压变化
scenario.goal_zh: 描述声音发生时机及可见状况，确认上门检查时间而不提前断定故障原因

context_zh: 住户哈娜给维修人员维克打电话，说明水管声音与水压的变化；尚未确定原因。
author: author-phase06-a

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: There is a repeated knocking sound behind my kitchen wall.

sentences.speaker: Vic
sentences.text: Does it occur when you turn the tap off, or at other times too?

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Mostly just after I turn it off. I think it is the pipe under the sink.

sentences.speaker: Vic
sentences.text: Have you noticed any change in the water pressure?

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: It seems weaker this week. Is the cause obvious from that?

sentences.speaker: Vic
sentences.text: No, I need to inspect it before I can say. Is there any water on the floor?

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: No. The cupboard and floor are dry. Could you come tomorrow morning?

sentences.speaker: Vic
sentences.text: I can come between nine and ten. Please leave the cupboard accessible, but do not take anything apart.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: That time works. I'll be here to show you where I hear it.
